hero.title: Building Digital Experiences.
hero.subtitle: I build clean, responsive React interfaces with strong UX and a performance-first mindset.
hero.quote: “Modern solutions built with technical precision and clean design.”

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I’m Vladi Georgiev from Bulgaria. After studying electronic trades in high school, I earned seven professional certificates in front-end development from Meta.
about.p2: I build websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and UI/UX design. I’ve also worked on C# projects using Razor and Blazor.
about.mobile_msg: For the best experience on mobile, please open the file directly.

ourgrid.title: OurGrid (Client OpenRemote)
ourgrid.desc: A platform demystifying 'grid congestion' for the company OpenRemote. I designed the UI and validated the UX with real users (students & coaches) to translate complex data into a clean React interface.
ourgrid.outcome1: Validated UX via testing with real users
ourgrid.outcome2: Architected a split-view UI for Residents vs. Municipalities
ourgrid.outcome3: Translated technical IoT data into accessible web components

mario.title: Mario & Luigi's Pizza
mario.desc: A full-stack Italian restaurant app with auth and a shopping cart. I designed the authentic visual identity in Figma and built the responsive frontend connected to a Python Flask backend.
mario.outcome1: Designed the UI/UX & assets in Figma
mario.outcome2: Developed the product card grid & cart logic
mario.outcome3: Integrated Python Flask for routing & auth

fitfusion.title: Fit Fusion
fitfusion.desc: A gamified health ecosystem where physical steps nurture a virtual pet. I led a 6-person agile team and handled the technical integration between the Unity game and the Web platform.
fitfusion.outcome1: Led the agile team & coordinated integration
fitfusion.outcome2: Developed the Web Frontend & C# Razor Pages

brewbuddy.title: BrewBuddy
brewbuddy.desc: A dedicated Full Stack inventory app for my student house. I built a custom C# API to manage complex storage data and connected it to a responsive React frontend, ensuring our beverages never ran out.
brewbuddy.outcome1: Developed a C# .NET REST API with an SQL database
brewbuddy.outcome2: Visualized and documented backend endpoints using Swagger
brewbuddy.outcome3: Created a mobile-first React UI for real-time stock updates

space.title: Space Invasion
space.desc: A classic arcade shooter reimagined with modern web technologies. Players defend Earth from waves of alien invaders using a custom-built game engine on the HTML5 Canvas.
space.outcome1: Implemented collision detection & physics from scratch
space.outcome3: Managed game state, levels, and local high scores

journey.title: Journey
journey.2019_desc: Started a multidisciplinary high school program combining Economy, Business, and Web Development. Graduated with a diploma as an Organizer of Internet Applications.
journey.2023_desc: Participated in the TF-FEST International Exhibition. Earned foundational certificates in Version Control and Introduction to Front-End.
journey.2024_desc: Solidified front-end expertise by mastering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Earned Meta certificates in React Basics and Advanced React.
journey.2025_desc: Expanding into full-stack development with C#, Razor, and Blazor. Focusing on UI/UX design and collaboration in agile teams.
